# pkguard

> Scan package-manager security settings and advisories across monorepos and folders of projects. Rust binary; `pkguard scan` is read-only.

## Install

```
cargo install --git https://github.com/jackmcpickle/pkguard pkguard
```

Requires a stable Rust toolchain. A Homebrew tap and prebuilt binaries land with the distribution cutover.

## Commands

See https://pkguard.dev/docs/commands for flags dumped from the binary (`pkguard dump-catalog`).
